emptyState

@Input()
emptyState: any = 'No list items to show'
  • Defined in packages/angular/src/list/ai-list.component.ts:175

Text that is displayed when list is empty. To change the default icon with the text, this can also be set to a TemplateRef.

The reason we are using type any instead of string | TemplateRef<any>, which is the only two types that should be accepted, is because passing emptyState into ngTemplateOutlet would cause the error: Type 'string | TemplateRef<any>' is not assignable to type 'TemplateRef<any>' to come up while building.
